compensation_policy.fixed_pay: MB fixed pay unchanged from 1-Jan-2022 through 2024; SB (17-Dec-2024) proposed a three-year increase (amounts not indexed)
compensation_policy.annual_variable: 70% quantitative / 30% qualitative criteria (2025); targets: Martire 100% (cap 170%), Guyot 100% (cap 170%), Lecharny 70% (cap 119%) of fixed
compensation_policy.lti: Performance shares; annual grant value 2.25x / 1.75x / 1.66x annual compensation (Martire / Guyot / Lecharny), maintained by SB on 16-Dec-2025; 3-year vesting; conditions: revenue vs business plan, consolidated EBIT vs business plan, quantifiable CSR indicator, relative TSR vs EuroStoxx 600; max vesting 120% (plan 17 vested at 120%)
compensation_policy.supplementary_pension: Supplementary retirement plan (annuity rights) for ExCo members incl. MB, introduced by AGM 20-May-2021; insurer Predica (then an Elis shareholder); 2025 provisions EUR 930,059 / 364,150 / 362,631
compensation_policy.severance: Forced departure only; cap 18 months of average fixed+variable pay of last two full years; conditions on rolling 24-month revenue and EBIT vs budget (none met: 0; one met: two-thirds = 12 months; both: full); not due for fault, internal role change or imminent retirement; renewal of these benefits submitted to AGM 21-May-2026
compensation_policy.non_compete: 12 months (Chairman) / 6 months (other members); 50% of gross fixed+variable of last full year, paid in instalments, if SB enforces
compensation_policy.share_holding_requirement: Chairman retains one-third of vested shares until holding = 3x annual fixed pay; other members 2x; SB members >= 500 shares
compensation_policy.supervisory_board_chair_fee: Thierry Morin fixed fee raised from EUR 186,000 to EUR 400,000 for 2025 (+115% [calc]) to align with panel average
compensation_policy.total_pay_amounts: EUR amounts of fixed, variable and total compensation per executive are in tables that are not indexed - not available in S&P/ProntoNLP
